lines.japanese: お？
lines.english: Hm?

lines.japanese: 家に着いたら、かわいい靴が綺麗に三足揃えてあった。
lines.english: When I got home, I found three pairs of cute little shoes lined up neatly.

lines.japanese: これはもしかして、うちのかわいい小鳩のお友達、かわいい吉川さんとかわいいアリスが遊びに来てるのかな。
lines.english: Could this mean my adorable Kobato's adorable friends—adorable Yoshikawa and adorable Alice—had come over to play?

lines.japanese: 三人が和気あいあいと炬燵でみかんでも食べてる姿を想像したら、それだけで心がぽかぽか温まってきた。
lines.english: Just imagining the three of them happily eating tangerines around the kotatsu warmed my heart.

lines.japanese: 俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないけど、かわいいからなあ、うちの妹＆その友達。
lines.english: I don't have a sister complex or a thing for little girls or anything. My little sister and her friends are just so cute.

lines.japanese: あの子たち、俺が登場したら「わあい」と喜んでくれるからなあ。
lines.english: They always shout “Yay!” when I show up too.

lines.japanese: 「あれっ？　いまだれか帰ってくる音しなかった？」
lines.english: “Hmm? Didn't it sound like somebody just came home?”

lines.japanese: 「もしかしてお兄さんじゃない？　そろそろ家に着く時間だし……」
lines.english: “Could it be Big Brother? It's about time for him to get home...”

lines.japanese: 「ならば我々は彼を出迎えてあげるべきだ」
lines.english: “Then we should go welcome him.”

lines.japanese: 途端に居間からの声が色めきだした。がたがたと襖が慌ただしく開き、笑顔の少女たちが廊下へ飛びだしてくる。
lines.english: The voices in the living room instantly brightened. The sliding door rattled open, and three smiling girls burst into the hall.

lines.japanese: 「わあっ、やっぱりお兄ちゃんだ。おかえりなさーい」
lines.english: “Yay, it is Big Brother! Welcome home!”

lines.japanese: 「わあい、学校帰りのお兄さんだあ。こんばんはー、今日もお邪魔してます」
lines.english: “Yay, Big Brother's home from school! Good evening. Thanks for having me again!”

lines.japanese: 「ドラ、今日もお勤めごくろうさまだ。まずはこたつへ入って休むといい」
lines.english: “Dora, good work today. You should get under the kotatsu and rest.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うう～っ！」
lines.english: “U-uuugh!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、急に顔隠してどうしたの。寒かったから鼻の頭いたいの？」
lines.english: “Huh? Why'd you suddenly cover your face? Did the cold make the tip of your nose hurt?”

lines.japanese: 「ちが、違うんだよ小鳩。う、うう～っ」
lines.english: “Th-that's not it, Kobato. U-uuugh!”

lines.japanese: なんて期待を裏切らない子たちなんだろう。「わあいと喜んで」なんて慣用句レベルで使ってたけど、まさかほんとにわあいと喜んでくれるとは思わなかった。
lines.english: They never let me down. I'd used “shout ‘Yay!’” as nothing more than an expression, never dreaming they would literally shout “Yay!” for me.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、みかんあるよ。一緒に食べようよ」
lines.english: “There's tangerines, Big Brother. Come eat with us.”

lines.japanese: 「私たちがいたから、お部屋も温かいですよ」
lines.english: “We've been in here, so the room's nice and warm.”

lines.japanese: 「ドラ、あなたはココアを飲むといい。体がとても温まる」
lines.english: “Dora, you should drink some cocoa. It will warm you right up.”

lines.japanese: 「うっ、うわ、うわああーっ！　うわっ、うわああああーんっ！」
lines.english: “U-uwah... Waaaaah! WAAAAAAAAH!”

lines.japanese: 「どどっ、どうしたのお兄ちゃん！？」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-what's wrong, Big Brother?!”

lines.japanese: ひとは己の器に収めきれない優しさを与えられたとき、感動を液体へと凝縮させて目から逃がすものなのでしょう。
lines.english: When people receive more kindness than the vessel of their hearts can contain, perhaps they condense their emotion into liquid and let it escape through their eyes.

lines.japanese: そんなポエムを生みださずにはいられないほどの幸せ空間が、我が家には出来あがっていた。あっ、俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか考えたこともないけどね。
lines.english: My home had become such a paradise that I couldn't help composing poetry about it. Oh, but I've never even considered having a sister complex or a thing for little girls.

lines.japanese: そんなわけで、四人仲良くｉｎザこたつ。
lines.english: And so the four of us nestled happily under the kotatsu.

lines.japanese: 俺は彼女たちの会話に口を挟まず、漫然とみかんを食いながら聞いていた。なにせこの子たちの会話は、浴びているだけで温泉×２０倍の癒し効果があるからな。
lines.english: I ate tangerines and listened without interrupting their conversation. Simply bathing in these girls' voices had twenty times the soothing power of a hot spring.

lines.japanese: だが、黙ってる理由はそれだけじゃない。現在、話の向きはとても興味深い方へ流れはじめていた。恋愛話だ。
lines.english: That wasn't the only reason I kept quiet, though. The conversation had begun flowing in a very interesting direction: romance.

lines.japanese: 「私は昨日、男の子からラブレターを受けとった」
lines.english: “Yesterday, I received a love letter from a boy.”

lines.japanese: 「ええーっ、ほんと？」
lines.english: “No way! Really?”

lines.japanese: 「わー、アリスちゃんすごーい！　子供なのに大人ー！」
lines.english: “Wow, Alice! You're so grown-up even though you're a kid!”

lines.japanese: 「モテる女は辛いわね」
lines.english: “Being popular is such a burden.”

lines.japanese: ちらり。アリスは俺の顔を盗み見ると、ブロンドの髪を右手でさらりと流してみせる。
lines.english: Glance. Alice stole a look at my face, then swept her blond hair aside with one hand.

lines.japanese: 俺は嬉しかった。今までこの異国の少女が、自分から楽しそうに学校の話をしたことなんて、一度もなかったからだ。
lines.english: I was happy. Not once before had this foreign girl volunteered a cheerful story about school.

lines.japanese: 「そうか、学校に友達できたんだな。よかったよかった」
lines.english: “So you've made a friend at school. Good for you.”

lines.japanese: 「ぷー」
lines.english: “Hmph.”

lines.japanese: 俺は誉めたつもりだったが、アリスにはヘソを曲げられてしまった。
lines.english: I'd meant it as praise, but Alice took offense.

lines.japanese: 「これだから鈍い男は困るわね。ひとのものになってからじゃ遅いのよ」
lines.english: “This is why dense men are hopeless. It'll be too late once she's somebody else's.”

lines.japanese: 「それでそれで？　なんて書いてあったの？」
lines.english: “And then? And then? What did he write?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩はラブレターの方に興味津々みたいだ。吉川さんも珍しく身を乗りだしている。
lines.english: Kobato seemed fascinated by the love letter. Even Yoshikawa leaned forward, which was unusual for her.

lines.japanese: そんな彼女たちの鼻先へ、アリスが封筒を突きだす。
lines.english: Alice thrust the envelope under their noses.

lines.japanese: 「これがその手紙だ。読みたければ読むがいい」
lines.english: “This is the letter. You may read it if you wish.”

lines.japanese: 「わー、すごーい、本物のラブレターだー」
lines.english: “Wow! An actual love letter!”

lines.japanese: 「なんだか私たちまでどきどきするね」
lines.english: “It's making even us nervous.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が広げた便箋を、俺も首を伸ばして覗きこんだ。
lines.english: I craned my neck to peer at the stationery Kobato unfolded.

lines.japanese: その内容を要約するとこうだ。
lines.english: To summarize, it said this:

lines.japanese: 『直接話すと通じにくいから手紙で伝えます。宿題だった「私の冬休み」の作文を今週中に提出してください。学級委員長より』
lines.english: “I'm writing because you have trouble understanding me when we speak. Please turn in your ‘My Winter Vacation’ essay by the end of this week. Your class president.”

lines.japanese: ラブレターじゃなくて督促状だった。
lines.english: It wasn't a love letter. It was a late-work notice.

lines.japanese: 「わー、アリスちゃんすごいねー。大人の女だー」
lines.english: “Wow, Alice, that's amazing. You're a grown woman now.”

lines.japanese: 「すごいすごーい。アリスちゃん、恋愛映画の主人公みたーい。ラブレターフロム品田だー」
lines.english: “So amazing! Alice, you're like the heroine of a romance movie! Love Letter from Shinada!”

lines.japanese: いや、君たちちゃんと文章読んだ？　ていうか品田さん誰？
lines.english: Did you two actually read the letter? And who the hell was Shinada?

lines.japanese: 「イギリスではニチジョー……サ、サハンジー？　のことよ」
lines.english: “In England, this is an everyday... occurr... occurrence.”

lines.japanese: アリスは鼻高々だ。うん、そうだな、今後は日本語の読み書きもちゃんと教えていこう。
lines.english: Alice was positively bursting with pride. Right. From now on, I would make sure to teach her how to read and write Japanese too.

lines.japanese: 「ふふ、私の魅力に気づいてないのは、一人くらいじゃないかしら」
lines.english: “Heehee. I suppose there's only one person who hasn't noticed my charms.”

lines.japanese: 何故かアリスは、さっきから俺の顔をチラッチラ横目で見ていた。
lines.english: For some reason, Alice kept stealing sidelong glances at me.

lines.japanese: なんだ……これはその……意識してる素振りでも見せた方がいいんだろうか。
lines.english: What was this...? Should I... act as though I was conscious of her too?

lines.japanese: そもそもこの子は、何をもって羽田ヨージをそんなに高く評価しているのだろう。いやこの場合、成田隼人に対しての感情か。
lines.english: What did this girl see in Youji Haneda that made her think so highly of him in the first place? Or were those feelings for Hayato Narita?

lines.japanese: まあ、あのぐらいの子供は、みんな年上の異性に憧れたりするものだし、嬉しいは嬉しいけど──
lines.english: Well, children her age often developed crushes on older people. I was flattered, sure, but—

lines.japanese: はっ！？　そうか、まだ若いとはいえ、アリスも立派な異性だ！
lines.english: Wait! That's right. She might be young, but Alice was still a member of the opposite sex!

lines.japanese: もちろん俺はロリコンでもペドフィリアでもないのだけど、恋愛に歳の差は関係ないとも聞く。あるいは選択肢として１００パーないとも言いきれまい。
lines.english: Naturally, I had no Lolita complex and was no pedophile, but people did say age had nothing to do with love. Perhaps I couldn't declare with absolute certainty that she wasn't an option.

lines.japanese: よし、ちょっと心の視野を広げて、今までとは違う意識で彼女を──
lines.english: All right. I would broaden my heart's horizons and look at her in a new light—

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうだ。この手紙見てたら思いだしたけど、今日はアリスちゃんの宿題を手伝う予定だった」
lines.english: “Oh, right. This letter reminded me that we were going to help Alice with her homework today.”

lines.japanese: 「そうです、今日は分数のかけ算を手伝ってください」
lines.english: “Yes. Please help me multiply fractions today.”

lines.japanese: 分数のかけ算……。
lines.english: Multiplying fractions...

lines.japanese: あまりの初等教育っぷりに、俺の恋愛メーターが計測不能に陥った。ていうか、電源が落ちた。
lines.english: The sheer elementary-schoolness of it drove my romance meter beyond the limits of measurement. In fact, it shut off entirely.

lines.japanese: 目の前で教科書・ノート・ふで箱を取りだすアリスの姿は、どう頑張っても恋愛へ結びつけられそうにない。
lines.english: Alice took out her textbook, notebook, and pencil case before me. No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't connect the sight to romance.

lines.japanese: うむ。やはり駄目だな。女を愛する心と子供を慈しむ気持ちは別物だ。ほら俺、シスコンとかロリコンとかまるで当てはまらないしさ。
lines.english: Indeed. It was no good. Loving a woman and cherishing a child were two different things. See? A sister complex and a thing for little girls didn't describe me at all.

lines.japanese: 「それにしても驚いたねー。私たちも、ラブレターなんてもらってみたいねー」
lines.english: “Still, what a surprise. We'd like to get love letters someday too.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえたちにはまだ早い！！」
lines.english: “YOU TWO ARE TOO YOUNG!”

lines.japanese: ふざけるな！　小鳩や吉川さんにララララブレターなんて出す不埒なヤロウがいたら、お兄ちゃんがやっつけてやる！　ふんがらがっがー！
lines.english: Like hell! If some shameless bastard ever sent Kobato or Yoshikawa a l-l-l-love letter, Big Brother would beat him up! RUNGALUNGAGAAAH!

lines.japanese: この二人にはチャラい男や擦れた生活などとは無縁な、健全で美しいもりもりした学校生活を歩んでほしいものだ。あ、べつに嫉妬とか焼きもちとか、そういうの全然ないけどね。
lines.english: I wanted those two to enjoy a healthy, beautiful school life, full to bursting and untouched by sleazy boys or worldly corruption. Oh, and this had nothing whatsoever to do with jealousy.
